new_articles.title: SK Hynix says Solidigm suspends review of US IPO, citing market volatility
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'SK Hynix says Solidigm suspends review of US IPO, citing market volatility'이다. Channel NewsAsia is an English-language news organization based in Singapore. SEOUL, Oct 23 : South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix said on Friday that it had suspended its review of a US initial public offering for its Solidigm subsidiary, citing financial market volatility and share price trends. South Korea's financial regulator said earlier this week that the listing could run afoul of. SK Hynix said in a statement it would continue to explore ways to fund Solidigm's expansion and enhance shareholder value, including reviewing the timing, scale and financing of future investments Despite strong business performance at both SK Hynix and Solidigm, the company said increased market volatility and a broader correction in semiconductor stocks had prompted it to reconsider the listing Shares in SK Hynix have fallen more than 30 per cent since the potential Solidigm IPO was reported in late September, compared with a 20 per cent decline in South Korea's benchmark KOSPI index over the same period Solidigm, based in Rancho Cordova, California, is SK Hynix's US subsidiary specialising in NAND flash memory and solid-state drives SK Hynix had considered an IPO as one of several ways to finance Solidigm's expansion amid growing demand for memory chips driven by artificial intelligence. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
